title: toxicodendron radicans subsp. diversiloba
intro: Toxicodendron radicans subsp. diversiloba, commonly known as the poison oak of the Pacific, is a plant species known for its irritant properties. It is used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Toxicodendron radicans subsp. diversiloba include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
